      2 name: GitOps.PullRequestIssueManagement
      3 description: Handlers when "No-Recent-Activity" label is added

      9   resourceManagementConfiguration:
     10     eventResponderTasks:
     11       - description: >-
     12           When the label "No-Recent-Activity" is added to a pull request
     13           * Add the PR specific reply notifying the issue author of pending closure
     14         if:
     15           - payloadType: Pull_Request
     16           - labelAdded:
     17               label: No-Recent-Activity
     18         then:
     19           - addReply:
     20               reply: >-
     21                 Hello @${issueAuthor},
     22 
     23 
     24                 This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has been marked as requiring author feedback but has not had any activity for **7 days**. It will be closed if no further activity occurs **within 7 days of this comment**.
     25 
     26 
     27                 Template: msftbot/noRecentActivity
     28         # The policy service should trigger even when the label was added by the policy service
     29         triggerOnOwnActions: true
